meaning.en: that is vast, divine, unimaginable in form
meaning.hi: वह विशाल, दिव्य, अचिन्त्य रूप है

meaning.en: shining out subtler than the subtlest
meaning.hi: सूक्ष्म से भी सूक्ष्मतर चमकता है

words.sanskrit: durat sudure tat iha antike ca

meaning.en: farther than the farthest, yet also right here, near
meaning.hi: दूर से भी दूर, फिर भी यहीं निकट

meaning.en: for the seeing, resting right here in the cave of the heart
meaning.hi: देखने वालों के लिए हृदय-गुहा में स्थित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: na cakshusha grihyate na api vaca

meaning.en: not caught by the eye, nor by speech
meaning.hi: आंख से नहीं पकड़ा जाता, न वाणी से

words.sanskrit: na anyaih devaih tapasa karmana va

meaning.en: not by other gods, penance, or ritual action
meaning.hi: न अन्य देवताओं, तप, या कर्म से

meaning.en: through the clarity of knowledge, purified nature
meaning.hi: ज्ञान की स्पष्टता से, शुद्ध सत्त्व

words.sanskrit: tatah tu tam pashyate nishkalam dhyayamanah

meaning.en: then, meditating, one sees it complete and undivided
meaning.hi: तब, ध्यान करते हुए, उसे अखंड रूप में देखा जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this subtle self is to be known through the mind
meaning.hi: यह सूक्ष्म आत्मा चित्त से जानी जाती है

meaning.en: into which the life-breath entered in five forms
meaning.hi: जिसमें प्राण पांच रूपों में प्रविष्ट हुआ

meaning.en: the consciousness of all beings is woven by these breaths
meaning.hi: प्राणों से सब प्राणियों की चेतना बुनी है

meaning.en: once this becomes purified, this self shines forth
meaning.hi: इसके शुद्ध होने पर यह आत्मा प्रकट होती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whatever world one envisions with the mind
meaning.hi: जो जो लोक मन से कल्पित करता है

meaning.en: one of purified nature desires, and whatever desires
meaning.hi: शुद्ध-सत्त्व वाला जो इच्छाएं चाहता है

words.sanskrit: tam tam lokam jayate tan ca kaman

meaning.en: attains that world and those desires
meaning.hi: वह उस लोक और उन इच्छाओं को पाता है

meaning.en: therefore one who desires prosperity should honor the self-knower
meaning.hi: इसलिए समृद्धि चाहने वाला आत्मज्ञानी की पूजा करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this is the truth spoken by the sage Angiras
meaning.hi: यह सत्य ऋषि अंगिरा ने कहा

meaning.en: long ago; it is not learned by one without proper discipline
meaning.hi: बहुत पहले; इसे बिना उचित व्रत वाला नहीं सीखता

meaning.en: salutations to the great sages, salutations to the great sages
meaning.hi: परम ऋषियों को नमन, परम ऋषियों को नमन
